#include <assert.h>
#include <stdint.h>
#include <stdio.h>

#include "ts_pack.h"

int main(void) {
    TS_PACKAlefHandle config_handle = ts_pack_process_config_from_json("{\"language\":\"latex\"}");
    TS_PACKAlefHandle result = ts_pack_process("\\documentclass{article}\n\\begin{document}\nHello\n\\end{document}", config_handle);
